text: We're preparing for our North Canterbury Children's Athletics open days on Tuesdays October 6th and 13th.  Following these are open athletics training sessions for new and returning teen, senior and masters athletes.  With Canterbury Interclub competition starting 17th October, Secondary Schools Champs on 5th December, Oceania Masters in late January, there is something for everyone.  Pop  down from 6pm, introduce yourself to our coaches and check it out.

Tonight, is our FINAL training night of the winter cross country and road season! Can you believe it??? 
We will be having a fun session, with prizes.... 👀

Looking forward to seeing you all! Following this, we will have our between seasons break, then starting back again for our summer track sprints, running and walks season on October 5th at Ashgrove Park - Will also send reminders as we get closer to this date. See you all soon! 🏃‍♀️🏃💪
